diff --git a/cors.go b/cors.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..775e947
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cors.go
@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// CORSOptions configures the CORS middleware and Mux.EnableCORSWithOptions.
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns a starting point to change.
+type CORSOptions struct {
+	// AllowOrigin is the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header:
+	// "*" for any origin, or the one origin that may read the responses, such
+	// as "https://example.com". When it is empty the header is not sent.
+	AllowOrigin string
+
+	// AllowMethods are the methods listed in Access-Control-Allow-Methods on
+	// a preflight response. When empty, the methods that the requested route
+	// serves are listed, which is what the router already knows.
+	AllowMethods []string
+
+	// AllowHeaders are the request headers listed in
+	// Access-Control-Allow-Headers on a preflight response. When empty, the
+	// headers the browser asks for in Access-Control-Request-Headers are
+	// allowed.
+	AllowHeaders []string
+
+	// ExposeHeaders are the response headers that scripts of another origin
+	// may read, sent as Access-Control-Expose-Headers.
+	ExposeHeaders []string
+
+	// MaxAge is how many seconds a browser may cache a preflight response,
+	// sent as Access-Control-Max-Age. Zero sends no header, and so leaves the
+	// browser's own default; a negative value turns the cache off.
+	MaxAge int
+
+	// AllowCredentials sends Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, which
+	// lets scripts of another origin send cookies and read the response.
+	// Browsers refuse credentials with the "*" origin, so set AllowOrigin to
+	// the one origin when this is on.
+	AllowCredentials bool
+}
+
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns the options EnableCORS uses: any origin, the
+// request headers most APIs need, the methods of the requested route and a
+// preflight cache of one hour.
+func DefaultCORSOptions() CORSOptions {
+	return CORSOptions{
+		AllowOrigin:  "*",
+		AllowHeaders: []string{"Accept", "Authorization", "Content-Type", "X-CSRF-Token"},
+		MaxAge:       3600,
+	}
+}
+
+// CORS returns a middleware that sets the CORS headers of options on every
+// response.
+//
+// A preflight request is an OPTIONS request. The middleware answers it with
+// 204 when options.AllowMethods is set, since it then knows all that the
+// response says. When AllowMethods is empty, the methods come from the
+// router, after routing: Mux.EnableCORS installs the method-not-allowed
+// handler that answers the preflight with them, so use it to get them.
+func CORS(options CORSOptions) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+			setCORSHeaders(w.Header(), options)
+
+			if r.Method == http.MethodOptions && len(options.AllowMethods) > 0 {
+				writeCORSPreflight(w, r, options, options.AllowMethods)
+				return
+			}
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// setCORSHeaders sets the headers that every response of a CORS enabled
+// route carries, preflight or not.
+func setCORSHeaders(h http.Header, options CORSOptions) {
+	if options.AllowOrigin != "" {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", options.AllowOrigin)
+	}
+	if options.AllowCredentials {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
+	}
+	if len(options.ExposeHeaders) > 0 {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", strings.Join(options.ExposeHeaders, ", "))
+	}
+}
+
+// writeCORSPreflight answers a preflight request with 204 and the headers
+// that tell the browser what it may send.
+func writeCORSPreflight(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, options CORSOptions, methods []string) {
+	h := w.Header()
+
+	if len(methods) > 0 {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", strings.Join(methods, ", "))
+	}
+	if len(options.AllowHeaders) > 0 {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", strings.Join(options.AllowHeaders, ", "))
+	} else if requested := r.Header.Get("Access-Control-Request-Headers"); requested != "" {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", requested)
+		h.Add("Vary", "Access-Control-Request-Headers")
+	}
+	if options.MaxAge != 0 {
+		h.Set("Access-Control-Max-Age", strconv.Itoa(options.MaxAge))
+	}
